description: Client-side JavaScript code for handling marketplace interactions in an OpenCart admin panel, including filtering, API modal, purchase modal, download actions, comment management, and image gallery.

methods.name: onSubmitFilter
methods.description: Handles the submission of the filter form, updates URL, and loads filtered marketplace list.

methods.name: onChangeFilterInputs
methods.description: Triggers form submission on filter input changes.

methods.name: onPurchaseConfirm
methods.description: Handles purchase confirmation via AJAX, updates UI based on response.

methods.name: loadExtensions
methods.description: Loads extensions list into the page.

methods.name: onDownloadButtonClick
methods.description: Handles download button clicks, AJAX request, and UI feedback.

methods.name: onDownloadDropdownItemClick
methods.description: Handles download via dropdown item click, AJAX request, and feedback.

methods.name: addComment
methods.description: Submits a new comment via AJAX.

methods.name: addReply
methods.description: Submits a reply comment via AJAX.

methods.name: refreshComment
methods.description: Refreshes a comment or reply via AJAX.

methods.name: initializeGallery
methods.description: Initializes image gallery with Magnific Popup.
